title: 天明之约 · The Daybreak Vow · Janji Fajar
description: A duet in Mandarin for a prince and a princess. A war keeps them apart until daybreak.

title: Bintang Senja · The Evening Star · 暮星
description: A song in Indonesian. A star falls at twilight. A young bugler carries her back to the sky.

title: Let Me Rise · Biar Aku Terbit · 如日初升
description: A song in English. A young scribe paints the heroes of the temple wall. She wants a story of her own.

title: Un jour viendra · 终有一天 · Suatu Hari Nanti
description: A song in French. A village boy joins the imperial army as its lowest servant. His spirit never goes out.
